display_title: When I Meet My Childhood Friend as a Brooding Debtor
description:
Kwon Yu-dam is no ordinary boss. Raised in the shadows of loan sharks and syndicate enforcers, she rules her family’s front enterprise with a calm, unbothered demeanor.

 To her, violence is just business, and business is always quiet.
Until Seo Cha-jin walks back into her life.
He was her inseparable elementary school sweetheart, but the boy she once knew is gone. Standing in her office with a split lip and a manic gleam in his eyes, Cha-jin surrenders himself completely to her world. But he didn’t just come back to catch up—he came back obsessed.
When the clothes come off, Yu-dam realizes just how far gone her sweet childhood friend truly is. He hasn't just entered the underworld; he’s carved it into his own flesh. 
Dripping pre-cum and sporting a cock heavily modified with sub-dermal pearls—a body modification reserved for the most hardened thugs—Cha-jin has custom-built his body for one singular purpose: to absolutely wreck Yu-dam's pussy.
From the front to the back, he’s ready to claim her, shattering her peaceful routine in a storm of raw, depraved, pussy-crushing lust. 

Can Yu-dam keep her composure as her submissive childhood friend turns into a relentless sexual monster?
